Resistance +10%. When affected by hard crowd control effects other than suppression, grants a shield that negates (10% Health) damage for 5s.
(Cooldown: 15s)

Mana Shield
When Health drops below 30%, removes all crowd control effects and grants a shield that negates (500–1,000 + 100% Magical Attack + 7.5% extra Health) damage and increases Movement Speed by 30% for 4s.
(Cooldown: 90s).

Mirror Domain
Releases a scouting light wave that deals damage 4 times to enemies within a range of 1,200, each dealing damage equal to 3% of current Health and slowing them by 25%–50%. The scouting light remains within range for 2s, providing visibility and exposing stealth units, while also dealing damage and slowing enemies.
(Cooldown: 75s. If no targets are hit, 75% of the Cooldown will be restored.)
Roaming equipment active skill cooldown is shared by the team.

Agility Aura
Grants 20% Attack Speed and 15% Cooldown Reduction, and restores 15 Mana every 5s. Teammates within a range of 800 gain 50% of this effect.

Increases Main Attack Stat by 25–50
(1 main attack stat = 1 Physical Attack or 2 Magical Attack)

Guerrilla
Every 3s, grants 6 EXP, and grants 6 Gold to the teammate with the lowest amount of Gold.

Wielder does not take a share of the earnings from monster and minion kills, but instead gains a separate 25%-50% Gold and EXP (maxes out at the 20:00 mark).
If lane minions die and their Gold is not collected, 50% of the Gold will drop on the ground. Up to 600 Gold can be picked up.
Can quickly switch between Crimson Shadow roaming equipment at no cost (Cooldown 300s).

Mirror Domain
Libera uma onda de luz de reconhecimento que causa dano 4 vezes aos inimigos em um raio de 1.200; cada golpe causa dano equivalente a 3% da Vida atual e os desacelera em 25%–50%. A luz permanece no alcance por 2s, concedendo visão e revelando unidades furtivas, enquanto também causa dano e desacelera inimigos.
(Recarga: 75s. Se nenhum alvo for atingido, 75% da Recarga será restaurada.)
A recarga da habilidade ativa dos equipamentos de Roaming é compartilhada pela equipe.
